error[ZBX-E0909]: a trust bundle was refused
  cause  the text is not a bundle this zbx reads: a line is not an envelope, its
         signature does not verify, or its statement is not about one tree
  fix    export the bundle again with 'zbx trust export <tree>' where it was made
  more   zbx explain E0909 · rerun with --verbose for the full cause chain
  docs   https://zigbox.github.io/zigbox/errors/E0909.html
